identityReviewRetry.reason: The first hair correction leaves the native continuous straight blunt fringe replaced by visibly curled separated bang tips in the canonical crop.
identityReviewRetry.observedSource: Freshly viewed native source has a dense dark sandy-brown neck-length shag, straight rough front fringe with a continuous blunt near-horizontal edge, and broad moustache/separate soul patch.
identityReviewRetry.observedResult: Replacement fringe still curls into separated points and opens at the forehead; it resembles a generic loose wavy hairstyle rather than the distinctive native blunt-front shag.
identityReviewRetry.correction: Make the front fringe dense and mostly straight, ending as one continuous blunt roughly horizontal edge across the upper forehead, with only tiny irregularities. No curled or looped bang tips, parted forehead gaps, swept curtain fringe or large waves at the crown. Preserve shaggy straight neck-length side and back hair covering part of each ear; do not turn this into a shaved-side bowl cut. Keep native dark sandy-brown hair, pale blue-grey eyes, young smooth ruddy face, thick irregular moustache, separate soul patch and short jaw stubble at exact age 20. Preserve every complete preceding modifier.
